description: When the host class supports a query-scoping facility, generate one named query filter per entry; each filter, when invoked, builds a query constraining the associated attribute to that entry's value. When the host class does not support query scoping, no filters are generated and no error is raised. Exercises differing enumerations for both the supported and unsupported cases.

cases.expected_output:
filter=draft
filter=published
query filter=draft attribute=foobar value=1
query filter=published attribute=foobar value=2
